court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Shubham Shukla And Ors. vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin Secy Home And ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Shubham Shukla And Ors. (husband, father-in-law, mother-in-law, son of aunt)
parties.respondent_defendant: State Of U.P. Thru. Prin Secy Home And Ors.

facts_of_case: Marital discord and bickering after marriage; prior marriage between petitioner no.1 and Vibha Pandey, followed by compromise through Talaknama and agreement to live separately

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle disputes amicably and agree to terms.
legal_principles.held: The parties hereto declare that they will not institute any criminal or civil proceedings against each other or against any of the relatives or family members of other party in future in relation to any issue arising out of their marriage or any matter incidental thereto.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to a one-time payment as full and final settlement.
legal_principles.held: That the First Party will pay to the Second party a sum of Rs. 2,00,000/- only (Rs. Two Lacs only) towards one time full and final settlement of all her claims against the First Party in relation to all the issues which have arisen between them out of their marriage.
